contractType: Share Purchase Agreement (GmbH share deal, German law)
party: Halden Capital Partners GmbH (Buyer, our client)

rules.preferred: Seller pays back any Leakage between Locked Box Date and Closing, euro for euro, without notice period.
rules.fallback: Buyer must notify Leakage within six (6) months after Closing.
rules.never: A notice period shorter than six months, or a cap on leakage claims.
rules.guidance: Leakage is the core price protection in a locked box deal.

rules.preferred: Warranties given at Signing and repeated at Closing.
rules.fallback: Repeated at Closing only for title, capacity and the fundamental warranties.
rules.never: Warranties given at Signing only, with no bring-down at Closing.
rules.guidance: Without bring-down the Buyer bears all risk between Signing and Closing.

rules.preferred: Actual knowledge of the managing directors plus what they would have known after due enquiry (constructive knowledge).
rules.fallback: Actual knowledge of named individuals after due enquiry of their direct reports.
rules.never: Actual knowledge only, without any enquiry duty.
rules.guidance: Pure actual knowledge rewards the Seller for not asking.

rules.preferred: De minimis EUR 25,000; tipping basket of 0.5% of the Purchase Price (liable from the first euro once exceeded).
rules.fallback: De minimis up to EUR 50,000; basket up to 1% of the Purchase Price, tipping.
rules.never: A deductible basket (liability only for the excess) or a de minimis above EUR 50,000.
rules.guidance: Deductible baskets shift the first loss permanently to the Buyer.

rules.preferred: Cap at 30% of the Purchase Price for business warranties; title and tax up to the Purchase Price.
rules.fallback: Cap at 20% of the Purchase Price.
rules.never: A cap below 15% of the Purchase Price, unless W&I insurance covers the gap.
rules.guidance: Check whether a W&I policy is in place before conceding on the cap.

rules.preferred: No limitation applies in case of intent or fraud (Vorsatz oder Arglist).
rules.never: Narrowing or deleting the intent and fraud carve-out.
rules.guidance: Liability for intent cannot be excluded in advance (§ 276(3) BGB); fraud (arglistige Täuschung) must stay carved out. Red line.

rules.preferred: Warranty claims: 24 months after Closing. Tax claims: 6 months after final assessment.
rules.never: Less than 18 months for warranty claims.
rules.guidance: Buyer needs at least one full audit cycle after Closing.

rules.preferred: Full indemnity for pre-Locked Box taxes.
rules.fallback: Indemnity to the extent the taxes exceed the provisions in the Locked Box Accounts.
rules.guidance: Provisions in the accounts are the usual and acceptable carve-out.

rules.preferred: Buyer may withdraw before Closing if a Material Adverse Change occurs.
rules.fallback: MAC limited to target-specific events (no general market or industry events).
rules.guidance: MAC clauses are less common in German deals; deletion is negotiable but should be traded.
Ancillary-restraint guidance allows up to 3 years when goodwill and know-how transfer, 2 years for goodwill only; longer periods risk invalidity.

rules.preferred: No restrictions on the Buyer's post-Closing personnel decisions.
rules.fallback: Information and consultation undertakings, without dismissal bans.
rules.never: A ban on operational dismissals (betriebsbedingte Kündigungen) or job guarantees without a business case approved by the Buyer's investment committee.
rules.guidance: Escalate to the employment team and the deal lead: commercial decision with works council implications.

rules.preferred: German law; DIS arbitration seated in Frankfurt am Main.
rules.fallback: German law; DIS arbitration seated in Berlin or Munich.
rules.guidance: A foreign seat raises costs and enforceability questions for a German target.
